identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, 'Bay Area Creative Bac' (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 83-2011288), which its own website calls 'Bay Area Creative'
California Arts Council grantee page lists Bay Area Creative at an Oakland, CA address, matching the agenda's 'Oakland, CA'

Organization runs in-school arts residencies for children (including a residency at an Oakland elementary school), matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' no-cost agreement for an elementary school
research.notes: ProPublica/IRS lists the city as Hayward, CA, while the California Arts Council page gives an Oakland apartment-style address (1389 Jefferson St Apt C505), so address and headquarters were left null. No phone number found on official pages. No page found that explicitly names OUSD or Franklin Elementary; identity rests on name, Oakland location and school-arts work.

profile.summary: Bay Area Creative is a nonprofit arts education organization. It runs in-school and after-school workshops, residencies and summer programs in spoken word poetry, dance and visual arts for young people, and offers professional development for teachers.

sources.title: Bay Area Creative Bac - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
BAY AREA CREATIVE BAC - California Arts Council

review.notes: Exact name match to a 501(c)(3) (EIN 83-2011288) whose own site and CA Arts Council page show in-school arts residencies at Oakland elementary schools and a service area including Oakland, fitting a no-cost classroom agreement at Franklin Elementary; the IRS city is Hayward but the candidate correctly left address null. Summary, EIN, website and the role-based Director@ email are supported by the cited pages and the summary is neutral.
